results.title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground | News | Al Jazeera
results.snippet: One of the first major confrontations took place near Kacham, close to the Mali border, in early September. ISSP claimed to have killed more than 200 JNIM fighters, captured more than 30 others and seized weapons and motorcycles. The claim has not been independently verified. results.title: Mali’s recapture of Kidal: strategic value and reality | Military Africa
results.snippet: On October 6, 2026, a Malian and Russian convoy, supported by auxiliary state-backed forces, retook control of Kidal, the regional capital, from Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA).
